name: catchme-monorepo
description: CatchMe — Exception Flow Explorer for Visual Studio Code (monorepo root)

scripts.//test: Per-package unit and smoke tests, then the editor-API compile checks. The second half is not a turbo task because swapping @types/vscode is a whole-workspace operation, not a per-package one, and it must run even when every package task is a cache hit. It compiles against both pinned versions: the engines.vscode floor and the newest published one from tools/vscode-types-latest. Both block. See ADR-0019.
scripts.test: turbo run test && node scripts/check-vscode-api.mjs floor latest
scripts.//typecheck:vscode-api: The API half of `test`, on its own, for when that is all you want to re-run. Add --strict to turn an unreachable registry into a failure instead of a skip. See ADR-0019.
scripts.//build:server: Runs the Maven wrapper from server-java/ (mvnw resolves .mvn/ relative to the cwd, so the cd is required).
scripts.//build:all: Both halves: the TypeScript workspace and the jdt.ls analyzer jar. The Java step needs Maven and is slow on a cold p2 cache.
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:server && pnpm run copy:server
scripts.package: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter catchme run package
